title: Japan destroys the Russian fleet at Tsushima
summary: Admiral Togo Heihachiro's fleet annihilated the Russian Baltic Fleet in the Tsushima Strait after its months-long voyage around the world.
reason: Russia had sent its Baltic Fleet to break Japanese control of the seas after the fall of Port Arthur.
significance: The decisive battle forced Russia to seek peace and established Japan as a major naval power.
place: Tsushima Strait, between Korea and Japan
